name: Axis Line Chart
tags: chart line svg axis gridlines tooltip crosshair keyboard dark
note: A cardinal-spline path drawn via pathLength=1 dash animation, with a pointer and keyboard driven crosshair readout.

name: Gradient Area Chart
tags: chart area gradient clip-path tween segmented range svg dark
note: A CSS gradient layer clipped by a JS-tweened clip-path polygon, so switching range morphs the whole surface instead of redrawing it.

name: Grouped Bar Chart
tags: chart bar grouped legend toggle svg stagger relayout dark
note: Bars grow from a shared baseline transform-origin with a per-index delay, and toggling a legend key collapses one series while the other slides to the group centre.

name: Stacked Share Chart
tags: chart stacked bar percentage legend highlight svg dark
note: Whole columns scale up from one shared baseline origin, and a legend key sets a root state class that isolates a single series and reveals its labels.

name: Donut With Centre
tags: chart donut ring dasharray legend count-up center label dark
note: Ring segments are stroke-dasharray arcs on one circle radius, staggered in while the centre label counts up and swaps to whichever slice is focused.

name: Needle Gauge
tags: chart gauge semicircle needle spring arc dial svg dark
note: A single rAF spring integrator drives the needle angle, the arc dash offset and the counting number together, with the zone colour swapping at thresholds.

name: Sparkline Rows
tags: chart sparkline list rows delta selectable stagger svg dark
note: A metric list where every row owns a generated sparkline whose dash animation is restarted on select, over a staggered row entry.

name: Calendar Heatmap
tags: chart heatmap calendar grid svg tooltip keyboard levels dark
note: A real 20-week calendar grid built from today's date, with column-staggered bloom-in, arrow-key cell navigation and a tooltip that flips below the top rows.
